fixture.search_roots: only the generated fixture directory; saved offline before launch

timing_scope: Committed input through Rust/bridge and current Flutter post-frame. History/shelf include 120 ms debounce; usable list frame does not wait for preview decoding. Only completed current presentations are sampled, not every input attempt. Excludes IME candidate selection, GPU raster and physical display presentation.

resource_observation.scope: Mixed query and window use, including the first history/shelf cycle batch; process ancestry only. Not a same-state or long-duration leak proof.

post_close_object_counts.scope: After closing the shelf; one main engine remains. This is an object-count snapshot, not a total graphics-memory or leak proof.

observed_diagnostics.scope: Messages occurred during shelf teardown. The pinned local Flutter VSyncWaiter schedules delayed callbacks; their cancellation and complete helper release remain unverified. No private runtime workaround was added.

limitations: The Mac locked before a second shelf-cycle batch and explicit hide/resume sampling.
The shelf Flutter controls were not exposed in the automation accessibility tree; input/results were checked with screenshots and opt-in timing. No VoiceOver result is claimed.
File search scope was saved offline as fixture preparation; this run does not validate the previous interrupted Settings Save click.
Shorter retention with immediate deletion through the real confirmation UI remains pending; automated and prior startup-expiry coverage are separate.
Physical keyboard/IME, full Web/XPC helper attribution and same-state long-duration stability were not validated.
RSS compression and graphics caches differ from allocated object counts; these samples do not establish an improvement versus an earlier app.

file_query.discovered_during: Build 10 cold-start follow-up; reproduced and fixed in Build 11
file_query.reason: The original Launcher ready phase could acknowledge input before the asynchronous file search delivered its first batch. Original file_query numbers may describe an empty loading frame and are retained only for traceability. Functional file checks and other operations are not invalidated by this timing defect.
